Game Information

There are nine ways to win cash. Each play is $2. For just $1 more per play, add Power Play to increase non-jackpot prizes (except the Match 5+0) by 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10* times!

*The 10X multiplier will at a minimum be available for draws with an advertised jackpot of $150 million or less.

Match 5 (five white balls) and win $1 Million! Match 5 (five white balls) with Power Play and win $2 million, regardless of the Power Play number drawn!

  • How to play: Select five white numbers 1 through 69 and one red number 1 through 26 - the Powerball®.
  • Cost per play: $2
  • Jackpot: The jackpot is based on game sales and grows until a lucky player(s) wins.
  • Overall Odds: 1:24.87
  • Draw days: Monday, Wednesday and Saturday nights
